verdict.rationale: The evidence only shows that Salesforce APIs exist ('Discover Salesforce APIs & put them to work'), that external apps can connect to Salesforce data, and that the official CLI can query records (sf data query). Nothing in the pack documents bidirectional sync at scale. Missing for 10: documented API rate limits, upsert operations, change detection, bulk/at-scale write and sync mechanics, and independent hands-on corroboration.
